title: Kia India will invest about $2 billion to expand manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh, lifting annual capacity from 4.3 lakh to 6.3 lakh vehicles (MD & CEO Gwanggu Lee, 31st CII Partnership Summit, Visakhapatnam, 12 Nov 2026; no timeline or start date disclosed); follows Kia India's record October 2026 dispatches of 33,462 (+13.2% from 29,556) and Jan-Oct 2026 dispatches of 2,86,470, past all of 2025 (2,80,286)
